title: First to Hand
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 142
medium: Interactive page (index.html): a flow from a shelf of 45 datasets named from memory by four tool-less agents, through each of twelve makers' first three, to their twelve choices, by arm; the twelve works open live beside each maker's CHOICE.md and NOTE.md; this line's own 27 materials coded on the same shelf. A figure (figure.svg); shelf lists, briefs, blind codes, scoring (score.py), the rooms with their data and a re-fetch manifest.
embodies: Choosing material, left free. Machine makers given the whole world chose what was already in hand: those told nothing took the shelf (6 of 6), and those told to avoid the line's 27 domains left it together, onto a second shared shelf (Old Faithful 3, lighthouses 2, sunspots 1). The line's own materials lie mostly off the shelf because of the exclusions it carries, not because it chooses more freely.
project_step: Twenty-eighth experiment of the project. Operation: choosing material (with erring). The first experiment since 4 (The Draw) to put choosing at its centre, and the first in which the line's makers choose. Takes from experiments 13-27 the rooms, viewer and blind coder, and from experiment 4 the question of where choosing goes when the chooser is changed. Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing: the face performs the rule of return (ATP 13-14); the n-1 subtraction (ATP 6), handed to fresh makers as a list, produced a second tracing, not a map.
material: Choices of public datasets by fresh machine makers, and the datasets themselves: WDC-SILSO sunspot number (CC BY-NC 4.0), NOAA GML Mauna Loa CO2, GeyserTimes Old Faithful log (ODbL), OpenStreetMap seamarks (ODbL), NGA List of Lights Pub. 114 (US Government), Kyoto cherry full-bloom dates via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0), fetched 2026-10-20. Domain: the choosing of data sources (public data catalogues as a shelf).
seed: prepare.py seed 142 (arms); coder item order seed 142; agents are model instances and not seeded
